# Tushar Maru — Portfolio

> Videographer & Video Editor based in Mumbai, India.

## About
Tushar Maru is a skilled videographer and video editor with 2+ years of professional experience in creating dynamic visual content. Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. Known for meeting tight deadlines and producing high-quality, engaging narratives.

## Core Expertise & Services
- Videography: Celebrity BTS shoots, commercial brand videos, live music events, music albums.
- Video Editing: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, comic creator reels, sound sync, color grading, wedding highlight films.
- Associate Direction (AD): Operational oversight, team management, strategic shoot planning, crisis management on floor.
- Content Strategy: High-retention video cuts for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and digital campaigns.
